svg.aria-label: One writer, one export, two snapshot copies: 1. Login: ExternalSecret surrealdb-secret pulls the root user and password from 1Password item surrealdb. The pod reads them as SURREAL_USER and SURREAL_PASS. 2. Store: One replica writes RocksDB under /data on a 20Gi ceph-block claim. The Recreate strategy detaches the old pod before the new one mounts the volume. 3. Export: Before each snapshot, kopiur runs surreal export inside the pod for the production database in the open_notebook namespace. A failed export fails the whole snapshot. 4. Snapshot: kopiur writes the snapshot to Ceph on its own schedule and to the R2 bucket on a second, daily schedule. 5. Route: HTTPRoute serves the API on envoy-internal. Gatus checks /health, because the bare root redirects to a third-party site.
